mapper.select: SELECT a.name AS app_name, a.number AS app_number, a.icon AS app_icon, b.number AS domain_number FROM t_sys_app a LEFT JOIN t_sys_domain b ON b.id = a.domain_id WHERE a.id = #{appId} AND a.enabled = true AND b.enabled = true
mapper.update: UPDATE t_sys_menu SET number = #{number}, name = #{name}, level = #{level}, parent_id = #{parentId}, app_id = #{appId}, feature_id = #{featureId}, permission_id = #{permissionId}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, target_type = #{targetType}, external_url = #{externalUrl}, external_open_mode = #{externalOpenMode}, icon = #{icon}, description = #{description}, sort = #{sort}, enabled = #{enabled}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
